latest_release.name: Kumo 0.1.0
latest_release.body:
Kumo 0.1.0 is a rewrite in Go, MyGo, and React. Profiles, overrides, settings, and state carry over from 0.0.x.

- Topology canvas, setup, About, agent prompts, and `kumo prompt`.
- A guardian stops the core and clears a system proxy Kumo still owns after a crash or force quit.
- Port conflicts name the holder and can move to a free port.
- JavaScript overrides (`main(config)`). Linux amd64 and arm64 builds.
- Another app's system proxy is left alone; Kumo can reclaim on request.
- TUN permission is a one-time grant. New and unset TUN settings use the MIPS stack, which needs Mihomo 1.19.32 or later. Stored stacks are kept.
- The profile import dialog keeps its footer inside the popup.
- Swift sources and bundled Sub-Store are gone.

Limitations:

- macOS builds are ad hoc signed only. Gatekeeper blocks them on other Macs. This release does not sign with a Developer ID or notarize.
- In-app updates are off. About shows that updates are not available, and there are no update files. 0.0.x reads `latest.yml`, which this release does not publish, so those installs move to 0.1.0 by hand.
- Windows is not released.

detail.readme:
Kumo

A calm desktop client for the Mihomo proxy core.

Go + MyGo app · React UI · Agent-friendly CLI

Features · Quick Start · Usage · Architecture · Docs · Roadmap

--- ## Overview Kumo connects you through Mihomo without turning proxy management into a network operations dashboard. The first screen answers four questions: is Kumo connected, which mode is active, is the system proxy on, and which profile and nodes are in use. DNS, TUN, rules, logs, overrides and the routing topology stay one click away. ## Features | Area | What Kumo provides | | --- | --- | | Desktop app | One Go binary built with [MyGo](https://github.com/egoist/mygo): a native window with a React + [coss ui](https://coss.com/ui) frontend, a menu bar item and notifications. | | Topology | A React Flow canvas of entry → rules → groups → nodes, with selected paths, dynamic members, broken references and a text inspector. | | Leaves no trace | Quitting, or a crash caught by the guardian process, stops the core and clears the system proxy — only if Kumo still owns it. | | Plays well with others | Another app taking over the system proxy is shown, not fought; a port held by another program is named, with a free port offered. | | CLI for humans and agents | The same executable as `kumo`: stable commands, `--json`, dry-run, predictable exit codes. | | Agent guidance | Each page copies a ready prompt for a coding agent; the Kumo skill installs for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and `.agents`. | | First run | A guided setup with an animated preview of each step. | ## Quick Start Download the disk image from [Releases](https://github.com/AstraFoundry/KumoApp/releases), open Kumo and follow Setup. It finds a Mihomo you have, or downloads one. ### From source Requires Go 1.27+, Bun and, on Linux, WebKitGTK. ```bash bun install make dev # live reload make build # package into build/ make check # generate, go vet/test, typecheck, FSD and message checks ``` ## Usage | Group | Pages | | --- | --- | | Daily | Overview, Profiles, Proxies, Topology | | Inspect | Connections, Logs, Rules | | Configure | Core, System Proxy, DNS, TUN, Sniffer, Resources, Overrides | | Kumo | Agents, Settings, About | ```bash kumo status --json kumo start kumo proxies --json kumo select Proxy "Tokyo 01" kumo sysproxy on kumo topology --issues kumo prompt proxies # a ready-made prompt for a coding agent kumo -l # every command ``` ## Architecture ```text internal/domain rules: runtime, system proxy ownership, profiles, overrides, config, topology internal/application use cases shared by the app, the CLI and the guardian internal/infrastructure storage, Mihomo client/launcher, system proxy, ports, processes internal/interfaces cli (kumo) and desktop (MyGo bindings, window, tray, quit path) src/ React frontend in Feature-Sliced Design: app, pages, widgets, features, entities, shared ``` The backend follows Domain-Driven Design; the frontend follows Feature-Sliced Design. See [docs/README.md](docs/README.md). ## Documentation - [Product](docs/product/README.md) · [Interfaces](docs/interfaces/README.md) · [Core](docs/core/README.md) · [Operations](docs/operations/README.md) · [Quality](docs/quality/README.md) · [Roadmap](docs/roadmap/README.md) - [Agent index](docs/agents.md) for coding agents working on Kumo. ## Contributing 1. Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) and the document under [docs/](docs/) for your change. 2. Keep business rules in `internal/domain` and `internal/application`; surfaces only call services. 3. Run `make check`; for lifecycle changes also `make e2e MIHOMO=`. 4. Update `docs/` in the same change when behavior, architecture, persistence, permissions or tests change. ## License Kumo is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 only (AGPL-3.0-only). See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for the full text. Third-party components bundled or used by Kumo may be licensed under different terms. See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). ## Acknowledgements - [Mihomo](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo), the proxy core Kumo drives. - The Clash and Mihomo ecosystem, for the controller API conventions Kumo speaks. - [MyGo](https://github.com/egoist/mygo), [Base UI](https://base-ui.com), [coss ui](https://coss.com/ui) and [React Flow](https://reactflow.dev). ## Star History
